entities.summary: Donald E. Pelotte SSS was an American prelate of Abenaki descent in the Roman Catholic Church. He served as the third bishop of the Diocese of Gallup in New Mexico and Arizona from 1986 to 2008. Pelotte is commonly described as the first Native American to be appointed a Catholic bishop in the United States.
